meta.name: content-brief
meta.description: SERP-driven content brief for a target keyword — what ranks, what to cover, headings, questions, internal links from your own data. Use when asked for a "content brief", "outline to rank for X", "what should this article cover", or before writing any SEO page.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给一个目标关键词,拿到能排上名的文章大纲、标题与内链建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要写一篇想被搜索引擎排到前面的文章,却不确定该覆盖哪些内容。
copy.tagline_en: Give a target keyword, get a rankable article outline, headings and internal links
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're about to write a page that should rank but aren't sure what to cover.

howto.what: 需先接入 Ryze MCP 连接器。Claude 会抓取目标关键词的实时 Google 搜索结果，读排名前三的页面，再结合你站点的数据产出内容简报：标题与 meta、H2/H3 大纲、待回答问题、内链建议。
howto.when: 当你要求写「content brief」、「给 X 排名的大纲」，或在动笔写任何 SEO 页面前触发。

say.text: 给我一份『内容简报』，关键词是项目管理工具
say.note: 会基于实时 SERP 产出简报

say.text: 写一个能排上『项目管理工具』的大纲
say.note: 含 H2/H3 大纲与内链建议

say.text: 这篇文章该覆盖哪些内容？关键词是项目管理工具
say.note: 含要回答的 PAA 问题

howto.what_en: Requires the Ryze MCP connector. Claude pulls the live Google SERP for a target keyword, reads the top 3 pages, adds your site's own data, and returns a brief: title and meta, H2/H3 outline, questions, internal links.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask for a "content brief", an "outline to rank for X", or before writing any SEO page.

say_en.text: Write me a content brief for the keyword 'project management tools'
say_en.note: Builds the brief from the live SERP

say_en.text: Give me an outline that can rank for 'project management tools'
say_en.note: Includes an H2/H3 outline and internal links

say_en.text: What should this article cover? Keyword: project management tools
say_en.note: Includes the PAA questions to answer
